description: Data-dependent Node test files. Unlisted tests are source-only; source checks reject unclassified direct data readers. Inputs are repository-relative; a final-component * glob requires at least one matching file. Public scope reads only publishable gallery data; research additionally requires private exports or saved analysis inputs.

src/charts/calibration/runFit.test.mjs.reason: Reconcile saved metrics and blind halves from per-filter readouts.

src/lib/analogLadder.test.mjs.reason: Reconcile analog membership and predictions on the saved calibration.

src/lib/baselineComparison.test.mjs.reason: Reconcile frozen paired errors, contributions and applicability populations.

src/lib/calibrationChoices.test.mjs.reason: Cohort and protocol choices resolve to exported configurations.

src/lib/fullRangeVibes.test.mjs.reason: Reconcile exported scores against the frozen analysis predictions, plus spectral grids.

src/lib/guardrails.test.mjs.reason: Reproduce saved guardrail decisions for every exported configuration.

src/lib/improveLink.test.mjs.reason: Reconcile physical sample links against the source-network shards.

src/lib/mac.test.mjs.reason: Reconcile optical-conversion metrics against saved calibration and research tables.

src/lib/meetingCoverage.test.mjs.reason: Reproduce complete-pair counts and Deming fits from the saved meeting analysis.

src/lib/notebookAvailability.test.mjs.reason: Reconcile monthly, product and physical-filter coverage.

src/lib/pilotRecord.test.mjs.reason: Reconcile the provisional direct-reference pilot, identities and spectral grids.

src/lib/pmfCoverage.test.mjs.reason: Reproduce the archived PMF dominance distribution.

src/lib/rainSeasons.test.mjs.reason: Reconcile the rain-rule calendar against the saved Addis daily weather.

src/lib/referencePopulation.test.mjs.reason: Reconcile unique physical filters, carbon provenance and exclusions.

src/lib/referenceRank.test.mjs.reason: Reproduce the source-reference rank and ratio tables.

src/lib/satoshiSpectra.test.mjs.reason: Reconcile ranked analogs and the frozen 233-filter evaluation population.

src/lib/seasonalComposition.test.mjs.reason: Reconcile seasonal counts with the declared calendars.

src/lib/siteColours.test.mjs.reason: Check exported calendar colours against the source defaults.

src/lib/spartanPublic.test.mjs.reason: Validate the parser against the local public-source mirror, beyond synthetic cases.

src/lib/specification.test.mjs.reason: Reconcile specification filters and their evaluation-set-specific optical metrics.

src/lib/splitFit.test.mjs.reason: Reproduce the source notebook threshold table on exported filters.

src/lib/vibesMigration.test.mjs.reason: Reconcile the rank-70 export against saved grids, predictions, routing and fit diagnostics.

src/sections/instruments/quality/flowQc..reason: Reconcile rolling windows, flow distributions and daily unions against the saved instrument data.

src/sections/ml/pages/decision/decision..reason: Reproduce saved site and site-season comparisons.

src/sections/ml/pages/model-form/hips.te.reason: Reproduce saved optical transfer and VIP comparisons.

src/sections/research/common/blankLines..reason: Reproduce deployed-line blank fits and HIPS readouts.

src/sections/research/common/charcoal.te.reason: Reconcile saved spectral summaries and seasonal grouping.

src/sections/research/common/envelope.te.reason: Reproduce source-reference envelopes with the same physical filters and optics.

src/sections/research/common/explorerFit.reason: Reconcile saved model fits and per-filter dates.

src/sections/research/common/filterOnly..reason: Reproduce held-out temporal fits, errors and physical-filter identity.

src/sections/research/common/holdout.tes.reason: Reproduce the locked optical holdout metrics and source-domain splits.

src/sections/research/common/lotSpectra..reason: Reconcile lot, seasonal, derivative-grid and envelope results.

src/sections/research/common/massLead.te.reason: Reproduce the mass sensitivity on the source notebook physical filters.

src/sections/research/common/pythonPmf.t.reason: Reconcile held-out PMF metrics, archived factors and filter identities.

src/sections/research/common/rawBaseline.reason: Reproduce the paired source/network spectral distances.

src/sections/research/common/savedSites..reason: Reconcile saved site labels against research exports.

src/sections/research/pages/ethiopia/dat.reason: Reconcile Ethiopia calibration tables, provisional TOR pairs and physical counts.

src/sections/research/pages/ethiopia/spe.reason: Reproduce spectral summaries and repeated-scan accounting against saved tables.

src/lib/investigationHistoryCatalog.test.reason: Regenerates the investigation-history catalog from the research notebooks and their git history (scripts/build-investigation-history.mjs --check); a gallery-only deploy checkout has neither.

src/lib/hipsLinearise.test.mjs.reason: Recompute the closure workflow's saved Addis fits, season ratios and predicted exponent from the per-filter optical depths.
